$comment: Curated skill catalog for a Hermes profile. Machine-readable twin of docs/05-catalog.md. `folder` is the path under the skills root; `method` is 'hermes' (hub-tracked, updatable) or 'npx' (Vercel CLI copy). Commands are exact and were verified on Windows.

groups.why: Full architecture practice stack: design theory through construction documents, plus 10 country code dossiers with clause-level regulatory depth and 7 Python calculators.

Dubai Building Code, Estidama, Al Sa'fat, UAE Fire & Life Safety
IBC/IRC/IECC/IFC, NFPA, ADA, ASCE, state codes
Building Regs + Approved Documents, BSA 2022, BS 9991/9999
NBC 2016, ECBC, IS codes, state DCRs

groups.why: Standalone skills that plug into villa work: CSI specs, FF&E product research and schedules, sustainability EPDs, client decks, site reports. The NYC-zoning and studio-framework skills were skipped deliberately.
